info.title: Storage Rental API
info.description: Current refactored application contract. Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh business clock; VND decimal amounts. Invoice is a receivable and Payment records individual attempts. No balance wallet. Manual refunds require Staff evidence and final Facility Manager confirmation. Financial mock routes do not integrate with a bank.
